text:
maria: Heads up — CI integration for eng-ml is red across the board. Failing tests all show 401 from mock-kafka-connector when trying to fetch schema. Anyone rotated creds or touched the test secret store?

ci-bot: Job #4821 failed: test_kafka_ingest::test_schema_fetch — 401 Unauthorized
logs: curl -i http://mock-kafka-connector/lookup -> HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized

```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"token expired"}
```

aj: I did a secret rotate in the test-secrets store yesterday for staging — forgot this service was using the old token. Sorry, checking now.

lin: The test runner caches tokens in /tmp/ci_token_cache; if connector invalidated old tokens it might still present old kid. Can someone clear cache and rerun?

maria: Can someone kick a rerun of the failing pipeline? I'm bisecting to find earliest green.

sasha: Rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/4822 — I'll also run a matrix with cache-clear flag.

aj: Confirmed — rotation happened 02:10 UTC (PR #1823). The new token has kid "rot-2025". Deploy script updated, but I didn't update mock-service config. Pushing fix now.

devops-bot: Deploy started for mock-kafka-connector@staging — rollout 1/3 nodes

kevin: FYI, if tests started failing after 02:00 UTC, you can bisect with commit range 905..912 (I saw green at 905).

sasha: Rerun finished for run 4822, most tests passed but test_schema_retry is flaky (timeout). Logs attached.

```
[2025-08-12T02:34:12Z] WARN  schema_fetcher - retry attempt 3 failed: timeout after 5s
[2025-08-12T02:34:13Z] ERROR schema_fetcher - final error: upstream connection reset
```

aj: Fix pushed and hotfixed the mock config to use the new kid. Can someone trigger the specific job test_kafka_ingest?

maria: Triggered job 4823 with cache-clear flag. Monitoring. Thanks all.

ci-bot: Job 4823 started. Tests: test_kafka_ingest (1/20) ...

sasha: Looks green so far on the matrix. Will leave jobs running an hour then mark as resolved. :white_check_mark:
